description: This Java class 'SyncUtils' contains static helper methods for managing Android sync accounts and triggering sync operations. It includes functions to create a sync account and to trigger an immediate sync, utilizing Android's ContentResolver, AccountManager, and shared preferences.

classes.name: SyncUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing synchronization accounts and triggering sync requests.

methods.name: CreateSyncAccount
methods.description: Creates and registers a sync account if it doesn't exist, sets sync settings, and schedules periodic syncs. Also triggers an initial refresh if needed.

methods.name: TriggerRefresh
methods.description: Triggers an immediate, manual sync operation with high priority for data refresh.
